conflicts: Statement cashback redemption is shown as ₹0.20 in one table and ₹0.15 in a later table on the product page.
disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. Product-page changes are flagged from 15 May 2026.

joining.summary: The joining fee is ₹2,500 plus tax.

annual.summary: The renewal fee is ₹2,500 plus tax.

annual_waiver.summary: The renewal fee is waived on ₹4 lakh spend in the 12 billing cycles of the anniversary year.

forex.summary: Forex markup is 2 percent on foreign-currency spends.

fuel_surcharge.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

base_earn.summary: The Reward Benefits section states 5 reward points per ₹200 of retail spend. The statement cycle cap is 50,000 reward points.
base_earn.notes: A calculator on the page also mentions 4 reward points on daily and retail spend. Prefer the Reward Benefits figure.

accelerated.summary: The card advertises 5X on Myntra, Nykaa, Reliance Digital, and more. SmartBuy advertises up to 10X on hotels and flights and 5X on instant vouchers.

upi.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

redemption.summary: The Gold catalogue value is ₹0.65 per point. Flights and hotels are ₹0.50. Airmiles are up to 0.5. Products and vouchers are up to ₹0.35. Statement credit is listed as ₹0.20 in one table and ₹0.15 in another. Travel redemption is limited to 70 percent of the booking. Statement cashback and SmartBuy flights and hotels are capped at 50,000 reward points per month. Redemption fee is ₹99 plus tax.

expiry.summary: HDFC reward points typically remain valid for two years. Unused accounts for more than 365 days nullify points.

summary.summary: Domestic lounge is spend-gated on the preceding calendar quarter and tracked on SmartBuy. International visits are delivered through Priority Pass. Priority Pass visits inside India are charged.

domestic.summary: The card includes 3 domestic lounge visits per calendar quarter. Marketing copy also says 12 complimentary domestic visits as an annual value figure.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹60,000 in the preceding calendar quarter.

international.summary: The card includes 6 complimentary international visits per calendar year through Priority Pass.

conditions.summary: Priority Pass visits inside India are charged.

railway.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

dining.summary: Swiggy Dineout Good Food Trail advertises up to 10 percent off.

movies.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

golf.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

concierge.summary: Concierge and SmartBuy helpdesk numbers are listed on the product page. Boarding Edge offers spa, buffet, hotel upgrade, or airport transfer, any 2 per calendar quarter, via a boarding pass on SmartBuy through DreamFolks.

travel.summary: Emergency overseas hospitalisation cover is ₹15 lakh.

accident.summary: Air accidental death cover is ₹1 crore.

milestones.summary: Spending ₹1 lakh in the first 90 days unlocks Swiggy One and MMT Black Gold. Spending ₹1.5 lakh in a quarter unlocks ₹1,500 Myntra or Nykaa vouchers. Annual spends of ₹5 lakh and ₹7.5 lakh each unlock ₹5,000 flight vouchers. Unlocked milestones must be availed within 60 days.

welcome.summary: Welcome memberships are Swiggy One and MMT Black Gold after ₹1 lakh spend in the first 90 days.
